propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every patchset due to click 8.2.1 vulnerability PYSEC-2026-2132, blocking all Verified +1 votes
click is pinned at 8.2.1 in uv.lock but not in pyproject.toml; it is a transitive dependency via inspect-ai [eval] extra
inspect-ai caps click at <8.2.2 (requirement: click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3) and this cap persists in all inspect-ai releases through 0.3.251, making constraint-dependencies infeasible
override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in [tool.uv] allows uv.lock to resolve click to 8.4.2 and removes the advisory; the cap is stale and inspect-ai 0.3.251 runs cleanly under click 8.4.2
the override is a workspace-level directive consumed only by this repo s lock and CI, not published in wheel metadata, so downstream consumers are unaffected
